source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The change removes source-package and source-upload forwarding from the comm Make include while preserving upload and other package targets. The source-stamp fallback separately changes log.warn to log.warning and still returns when the file has the wrong line count. These are exact local changes; the author reports mach-based packaging, but the upstream implementation, generated package and uplift outcome remain unverified.
title: The source-packaging cleanup removes two comm Make forwarding targets
